dedupe_keys.name: cucd id simulated cubesat security telemetry and scenario scripts

description: CuCD-ID contains labelled command and telemetry records generated in a CubeSat software-in-the-loop environment at Ontario Tech University. The researchers use NASA NOS3, the core Flight System and COSMOS to reproduce nominal operation and four security-event scenarios. The release includes a balanced raw table with 25,000 rows and thirty-one columns, plus an augmented table with 22,465 rows and twenty-three columns. Features include packet-header values and statistics from twenty-second windows. Mendeley version 3 lists thirteen CSV, JSON, script and documentation files free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is entirely simulated and has no real orbital observation period. A limitation is that added noise categories and balanced classes do not represent operational spacecraft incident rates. A reviewer-assessed use is checking anomaly-monitoring components in satellite communications digital twins. platform-ns-3 is a related communications simulator, without a verified coupling to NOS3. No telemetry file, reproduction script, simulator or attack scenario was downloaded or executed.
